title: How Clay Builds GTM Agents — Jeff Barg, Head of AI
author: Basil Chatha
description: How $1,500 could qualify every company in the world, why customers hate the model selector, and how Clay is building go-to-market infrastructure for every agent
summary: Open video on YouTube ↗ Clay wants you to get about the same results whether you use its own agent or point Claude Code at Clay. Usage is already split close to 50/50 between Clay’s agent and outside harnesses.
takeaways: We also talk about why customers hate picking a model, how Clay plans to pick one for them, and why the team still runs its agents on a system it built with BullMQ, without Temporal or LangGraph.
Jeff tells us what happened when OpenAI called off Clay’s ChatGPT apps launch with two days to go.
We get into why customers hated Workflows at first, how agents came to build most workflows, and when post-training pays off.
